onboarding.headline: Nothing ripe should rot.
onboarding.intro: Free, public, edible trees exist all over this city. Free Fruits maps them, proves them, and rewards the people who find them.
onboarding.rule1Body: Open the map and see what is edible nearby, ranked by rarity and distance.
onboarding.rule2Body: Photograph it on site — the GPS stamp is what makes the pin trustworthy.
onboarding.rule3Body: Two foragers confirm it, and the points are yours, permanently.
onboarding.locationTitle: The map needs to know where you stand
onboarding.locationBody: Location powers distances, the 25 m check-in radius, and the nudge when you pass an unverified tree.
onboarding.cameraTitle: A tree only counts if you photograph it
onboarding.cameraBody: GPS is written into the photo the moment you take it — that stamp is the proof a forager was really standing there.
onboarding.notificationsTitle: Get told when the fruit is ready
onboarding.notificationsBody: A short nudge when a pin near you clears pending, or when something within 500 m comes into season.
onboarding.locationRefusedTitle: You can still read the map
